meta.title: Convert to Auction is offered on an RFQ whose bidding has ended and is in its evaluation time
gaps: Verify that the prepared RFQ is specifically in evaluation time, rather than only having bidding closed.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify that the prepared RFQ is specifically in evaluation time, rather than only having bidding closed.

plan.title: Convert to Auction offered during RFQ evaluation

steps.note: Open the API-prepared RFQ instead of searching the events list.
Open the published event's Settings menu.
Assert that Convert to Auction is present and clickable.
Open the conversion confirmation window without confirming the conversion.
Assert that the conversion window opened and offers Cancel.
Cancel the conversion so no event change is committed.
Reopen Settings after cancellation to verify the original action remains available.
Assert that cancellation left the RFQ unchanged and the action still enabled.
